propositions: A new NDJSON snapshot file must persist point-in-time code-health metrics (coverage, complexity, clone count) as an append-only log under .rebar/ for durable trend tracking across CI runs.
The write_snapshot() function appends a timestamped record and read_snapshots(since, until) yields records within a date range, with corrupt/truncated lines skipped without error.
The snapshot store path .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson must be explicitly un-ignored in .gitignore via a negation rule so it is tracked in git and persists across syncs, unlike gitignored /reports/.
Unit tests verify round-trip write/read, date-range filtering excludes out-of-range records, malformed lines are silently skipped, and the snapshot file avoids .gitignore matching.
